parts.t: [exhausted] [annoyed] After a long day's work, you try to hit the hay...
[through gritted teeth] [shouting] [furious] But this NIGGA climbs in bed with you!
[screaming] [enraged] GET THE FUCK OUT!
[seething] He climbs out of your bed and smiles at you as he leaves. [disgusted] Fucking creep.
[angry] [tired] So the next night, you lock your door and fall asleep...
[furious] But this fucking PRICK climbs through your window and he's back in your bed, [enraged] holding you like he's the fucking big spoon.
[seething] [through gritted teeth] Motherfucker, I swear to God.
[shouting] [furious] You kick him the fuck out of the house!
[angry] [determined] The next night you bolt the fucking windows down and go back to sleep...
[confused] You feel ceiling dust on your face.
[screaming] [enraged] Fucking CHRIST ALMIGHTY!
[furious] He's cutting a Looney Tunes ass hole in your ceiling.
[seething] You've had just about enough of his bullshit, [furious] so once again you kick his freaky ass to the curb!
[exhausted] You patch the hole, lay down in your bed and—
[screaming] [enraged] goddammit, he's back in the house! [furious] He jumps into your bed.
[whispers] [creepy] Hold me baby...
[whispers] [creepy] and don't let go...
[defeated] [bitter] He caresses you all night.
[defeated] Not sweet...
[bitter] [angry] fuck.
